title_en: Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Approving the Provisions of the Central Military Commission on Awarding the People's Liberation Army Meritorious Honor Medals to Retired Cadres of the Army

articles.content_en:
(Adopted on July 1, 1988)
The Second Session of the Standing Committee of the Seventh National People's Congress decides to approve the Regulations on Awarding the Meritorious Service Medal of the People's Liberation Army to Retired Army Cadres submitted by the Central Military Commission, and that the regulations shall be promulgated and put into effect by the Central Military Commission.
